howToApply: Visit the Commission’s website psc.uk.gov.in or pscuka.net.in to read the advertisement thoroughly.

Go to pscuka.net.in and click on the ‘How to Apply’ link in the Menubar. Review Advertisement Details, Important Dates, and Instructions for filling up the online application form, then click ‘Apply Now’.

After clicking ‘Apply Now’, fill in the Registration Form with correct details and create a Password for Login, then click ‘Submit’. Verify all filled information carefully. If correct, tick ‘I have verified all the details entered by me in the registration form and wish to submit the same’ and click Submit. Otherwise, select ‘No, I want to change some details’, click Edit, correct the details, and resubmit.
After submission, a Primary Registration completion message will appear on screen and a message will be sent to the Registered Mobile Number and Email. Then click ‘Click here to login’.

After login, the Educational Details page will appear. Fill in High School details and click ‘Add Education Details’. Similarly fill Intermediate, Graduate and other educational qualifications. Fill other details and click Continue. Then upload Photo and Signature as per instructions shown.

After uploading Photo and Signature, tick the declaration ‘I hereby declare that the photograph & signature are correct and accurate representation of myself’ and click Continue. The filled data will be displayed on screen.

Carefully check all filled details. If incorrect, click ‘Back & Edit’ to go back and correct. If correct, tick the declaration and click ‘Final Button’ to complete the online application process. Click ‘Print Application’ to get a printout of the online application form.

After Final Submission, if there is an error in the application form, the candidate can cancel the application and reapply by clicking ‘Cancel My Application’. After cancellation, no claim will be accepted for the cancelled application.
